reviews.comment: Attendance isn't mandatory but being at the lectures will definitely help improve your grade. READ THE BOOK!!! He is really nice and cares about his students. He also is very passionate about what he teaches and teaches it well. Awesome professor!!

There are 4 exams and they're specific, so make sure you take good notes during lectures and reread textbook before exams to get a great exam grade. Attendance is not mandatory, but still go for important insights. Read textbook.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
His lectures are thorough and clearly convey that not only he knows the subject but passionately enjoys it. Tests are fair and are limited to what he talks about in class. Once in a lifetime professor that authentically cares about teaching and engaging with students.

Only complaint: Course is too easy, did not do readings, textbook, nor study.

Dr. Rademaker is the epitome of a professor who cares about his students and loves what he does. Go up first day and shake his hand, chat for a bit, and I promise you'll stand out among those just taking this class to satisfy a requirement and nothing more. Easy + high weight papers, easy exams if you have eyes/ears, and posts all material online.

Rademaker is passionate about the content he teaches and wants his students to enjoy it too. Constantly promoted student feedback throughout the course. The only downside of the class was that people took advantage of the professors grading system and didn't show up to classes, ruining the experience of the class. Fun prof, highly recommend

I really enjoyed this class. The material is fairly easy to understand, and he is extremely accommodating if you need help. This has been the easiest class I've taken so far, and really only requires the bare minimum of effort. If you take the time to study for the tests, thought papers, and group projects, an A is extremely obtainable.
Very enjoyable lecturer, very willing to answer questions and give feedback. Exams are straight from the lecture slides AND readings.
I loved taking this course! He was such a great professor

This class is not hard but does require some effort, it is not an easy no effort credit. There are 4 papers that require you to watch a documentary and 2 group projects. The professor is super passionate but his lectures are sort of boring. there is no homework so if you do poorly on a test or project than it could tank your grade.

He is VERY passionate & loves his students that are too. Sometimes he funny but most lectures felt like eternity. Graded on: 2 Group projects(a paper & videoed presentation each), 5 short papers, 3 tests. Grades too strict for lv 200 course

- Only take him if you like archaeology
- You don't need to buy the textbook
- HE'S NOT CHILL ABT PHONES!!

I cannot put into words how amazing this professor is. He cares a lot about the topic, his students, and their learning. He posts the slides, and everything you need to know for the test is highlighted in blue in the slides. The book he requires for the class is an easy read. Read the slides and book, you'll get an A and enjoy doing it.

You can tell he loves the subject of archaeology. Lectures are interesting and he uploads most of the slides, but not towards the end of the semester.  A doable amount of short readings, tests have study guides, and there's 2 group projects. There is a textbook, I got by without reading it. I'd definitely recommend taking this class for a credit!!
